seoTitle: Which Arcane Character Are You? Arcane Test (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Arcane test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Vi, Jinx, Caitlyn, Jayce, Viktor, Ekko, Silco or Heimerdinger — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the fighter who'd tear down a city for her sister, the chaotic genius nobody can predict, or the inventor who wants to change the world? Answer 12 questions about how you really handle family, ambition and trouble, and find out which Arcane character you are.

characters.name: Vi
characters.title: The Protective Fighter
characters.summary: Tough, loyal and ready to fight for the people you love. You protect first and ask questions later.
description: Like Vi, you're a fighter. She grew up on the streets of the Undercity and learned to solve problems with her fists.
Everything you do is about protecting your family. Vi's whole story is about trying to save her little sister, Powder — even after Powder became Jinx.
You carry guilt and you carry it hard, but you never stop trying to make things right.
characters.flaw: You act on impulse and blame yourself for everything.
characters.signature: Wrapped knuckles, a tattoo on her face and a sister she'll never give up on.
characters.clashReason: they solve everything with their fists

characters.name: Jinx
characters.title: The Chaotic Genius
characters.summary: Brilliant, unpredictable and a little bit explosive. You've been through a lot — and you're not going to pretend you haven't.
description: Like Jinx, you're a genius inventor. She builds her own weapons and gadgets out of scraps — and they work terrifyingly well.
You're chaotic and impulsive. Jinx does what she wants, when she wants, and she's impossible to predict.
Under the chaos is a lot of pain. Jinx was once Powder, the little sister desperate to be useful — and she's still looking for someone who'll accept her.
characters.flaw: You let your past control you, and people get hurt.
characters.signature: Long blue braids, a manic grin and a very large gun.
characters.clashReason: they're pure chaos, and you never know what they'll blow up next

characters.name: Caitlyn Kiramman
characters.title: The Idealistic Enforcer
characters.summary: Principled, sharp and determined to find the truth. You came from privilege — and you chose to use it to do good.
description: Like Caitlyn, you believe in justice. She's an enforcer from one of Piltover's wealthiest families who could have lived an easy life — and didn't.
You're a sharp investigator and an even sharper shot.
You're idealistic, but you learn the hard way that the world is more complicated than you were taught.
characters.flaw: Your sense of justice can harden into something darker when you're hurt.
characters.signature: A long rifle, a clear eye and a family name that opens doors.
characters.clashReason: they'd drag you in front of the law, whatever your reasons

characters.name: Jayce Talis
characters.title: The Visionary Inventor
characters.summary: Charismatic, idealistic and full of big ideas. You want to change the world — and you're learning what that really costs.
description: Like Jayce, you dream big. He pioneered hextech, magic-powered technology that transformed Piltover.
You're charismatic and a natural public face. Jayce went from lab to council chamber faster than he was ready for.
You mean well, but power and pressure make everything complicated.
characters.flaw: You get swept up in power and lose sight of the people around you.
characters.signature: A hextech hammer and a speech about progress.
characters.clashReason: they'd rush ahead to look good before thinking it through

characters.name: Viktor
characters.title: The Relentless Scientist
characters.summary: Brilliant, quiet and driven by a vision of a better future. You'd sacrifice almost anything for progress.
description: Like Viktor, you came from nothing. He grew up in the Undercity and worked his way into Piltover's academy through sheer brilliance.
You're driven by the idea that science can end suffering. Viktor's own illness makes that urgent.
You're gentle and humble, but your drive can take you somewhere nobody expected.
characters.flaw: You'll push past every limit — including your own humanity.
characters.signature: A cane, a notebook of equations and a quiet, determined voice.
characters.clashReason: they'd sacrifice anything — even themselves — to finish the work

characters.name: Ekko
characters.title: The Rebel Leader
characters.summary: Resourceful, hopeful and fighting for a better future. You lead by example — and you never give up on people.
description: Like Ekko, you're a leader. He grew up in the Undercity and went on to lead the Firelights, a group fighting to protect their people.
You're resourceful and inventive. Ekko builds incredible tech with whatever he can find.
You still hold hope for people others have given up on — including an old friend who's become something very different.
characters.flaw: You hold onto the past — and the people in it — too tightly.
characters.signature: A hoverboard, a glowing mask and a community he'd do anything for.
characters.clashReason: they'd never let you get away with hurting their people

characters.name: Silco
characters.title: The Ruthless Visionary
characters.summary: Patient, ruthless and utterly committed to your goal. You'll do whatever it takes — and you'd burn the world for the people you love.
description: Like Silco, you have a vision. He wants the Undercity to become its own nation, free from Piltover — and he'll use any means to get there.
You're calm, strategic and frightening when you need to be.
Beneath it all, there's one person you love completely. For Silco, that's Jinx — the daughter he chose.
characters.flaw: You'll destroy anyone who stands in your way.
characters.signature: A scarred eye, a calm voice and a vial of glowing purple Shimmer.
characters.clashReason: they'd use you and never feel bad about it

characters.name: Heimerdinger
characters.title: The Cautious Mentor
characters.summary: Wise, patient and a little old-fashioned. You've seen what happens when people rush — and you want them to slow down.
description: Like Heimerdinger, you're wise — he's been around for centuries, and it shows.
You're cautious. Heimerdinger warns that some technology is too dangerous to rush.
People think you're stuck in the past, but you're really just trying to protect them from themselves.
characters.flaw: Your caution can make you slow to act when action is needed.
characters.signature: Wild white hair, a professor's coat and a very sensible warning.
characters.clashReason: they'd make you wait years for something you need now

questions.text: Your younger sibling messes up badly and gets you both in trouble. You...

options.text: Take the blame. You always do
Tell them it doesn't matter. They're yours, no matter what
Work out exactly what went wrong so it never happens again
Help them fix it, then let it go

questions.text: You're handed a problem nobody has solved in years. You...

options.text: Work on it every night until it's done, whatever it takes out of you
Build a flashy prototype and show it off by tomorrow
Warn everyone it'll take years to do properly
Throw something wild together from spare parts and see what happens

questions.text: Someone insults your friend right in front of you. You...

options.text: Hit them
Say nothing now. You'll get them back later
Make a scene. A big one
Calm it down, then check your friend's okay

questions.text: You're offered a seat at the table with the most powerful people in town — but you'd have to play their games. You...

options.text: Yes. You can change things from the inside
Take it, and use it to push for real justice
No thanks. You'd rather build things than make speeches
Turn it down. They've never done anything for your people

questions.text: You feel left out by the people you love most. You...

options.text: Do something big and loud so they can't ignore you
Hide how much it hurts and bury yourself in work
Confront them about it. Straight away
Go and find people who actually need you

questions.text: A whole weekend with nothing planned. You...

options.text: Tinker with a project until you forget to eat
Reread old favourite books, slowly, with tea
Go to a party where you'll meet people who matter
Make something loud and messy — paint, sparks, noise

questions.text: You sign up for a class. It's...

options.text: Target shooting. You've got a steady hand
Skateboarding — and you'll be teaching it by week three
Chess. You like thinking ten moves ahead
Public speaking. You've got big ideas to sell

questions.text: A friend you trusted betrays you. You...

options.text: Try to understand why. People are complicated
Never trust them again. Ever
It hurts — but you'd still take them back
Feel it completely — then lash out

questions.text: Someone much younger is rushing into a big decision you've seen go wrong before. You...

options.text: Warn them. Gently. Then warn them again
Let them learn the hard way
Back them. Young people change the world
Tell them straight — then stand by them when it goes wrong

questions.text: Your sister has done something terrible, and people are dead. The police want her. You...

options.text: Protect her. Whatever she's done, she's family
Hand her over. Justice has to mean something
Hide her, and tell her she did nothing wrong
Try to reach the person she used to be

questions.text: You invent something that could end sickness — but in the wrong hands, it's a weapon. You...

options.text: Keep going. The good outweighs the risk
Lock it away until you're certain it's safe
Share it, and trust the right people to use it well
Make it even more dangerous. Now it's interesting

questions.text: Your neighbourhood is being poisoned by a factory that the rich part of town profits from. You...

options.text: Organise the neighbourhood and fight back
Take over the factory and run it for your own people
Gather the evidence and force the people in power to act
Go there yourself and shut it down. With your fists
